Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Public portfolio announcement, architectural milestone, award, or publication authored by the verified portfolio owner.

summary.description: Concise description of the milestone, publication, or credential.

badge.description: Classification tag displayed on the announcement card.

linkUrl.description: Optional external HTTPS reference link (empty string when omitted).

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the portfolio owner who authored the announcement.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Server-provisioned RBAC marker identifying authorized portfolio administrators by UID.

/announcements/{announcementId}.description: Publicly readable portfolio announcements; writes strictly restricted to the verified portfolio owner.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-locked admin allowlist collection; cannot be modified or listed by client SDKs.
